newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar slips slightly but all eyes on NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar slips slightly but all eyes on NY.

text.p: Trading on London's white sugar futures market was mostly confined to crosses on the nearby August/October spread as players awaited the raws open and more position-juggling before May expiry.
All traded positions edged gently lower and ranges were tight across the board while August/October remained steady at around $9.00.
At 1110 GMT August was 70 cents lower at $314.20 and October down $1.10 at $305.20. Overall volume was a light 412 lots.

"A few switches have been crossed but overall it looks pretty mundane stuff," said one trader, noting that New York and the spec long position would be the focus of all trading interest before May raws expires on April 30.
Fresh physical news was thin, although traders noted the advent of rains to relieve parched beet crops in western Europe.
The Paris market saw a similar trading pattern with 193 lots posted on the board and all positions slightly lower. August was down 80 cents at $314.00 and October down by the same amount at $305.70.
